mod.Description: Dynamically deploys defensive fleets, scalable planetary garrisons, 4X logistics, and colonial mutiny mechanics.
mod.Author: Sadicto, GreenPerfectAlt

Option.Name: Fleet Scaling: Normal (1.0x)
Option.Description: Balanced 4X gameplay: dynamic Soft-Cap based on stars and captain rank.

Option.Name: Fleet Scaling: Minimal (0.2x)
Option.Description: Lightweight garrisons (10-15 vessels max) for low-end PCs.

Option.Name: Fleet Scaling: Ultra (1.5x)
Option.Description: Massive sector armadas for powerful systems.

Option.Name: Colonial Rebellions: Enabled
Option.Description: Garrisons risk defection during bankruptcy and heavy siege casualties (Zealots immune).

Option.Name: Colonial Rebellions: Disabled
Option.Description: No garrison mutinies under any circumstances.

Option.Name: Colonial Rebellions: Anarchy (2.0x)
Option.Description: Double rebellion frequency across the galaxy.
